title: Long-Tenure and Mid-Tenure Caps on Top-Performer Relief — Seller Performance Standing
content:
The top-performer cap is the long-tenure relief cap of 6 points for a standing record opened 1,095 days or more before the handling date, and the mid-tenure relief cap of 4 points for a record opened at least 730 but fewer than 1,095 days before. A record opened fewer than 730 days before the handling date takes neither of these caps.

The days are counted from the opening date of the seller's Seller Performance Standing record to the handling date.

| Days since the standing record was opened | Top-performer cap |
|---|---|
| 1,095 or more | 6 points |
| 730 up to 1,094 | 4 points |
| fewer than 730 | neither cap above |

## Basis Q&A

**A record opened exactly 1,095 days before the handling date?** The long-tenure relief cap of 6 points.

**A record opened 1,094 days before?** The mid-tenure relief cap of 4 points.

**A record opened exactly 730 days before?** The mid-tenure relief cap of 4 points; at 729 days neither cap above applies.

**Hypothetical application.** Rounded-down relief of 5 points stands in full under the 6-point cap and is held at 4 points under the 4-point cap.
